title: The Inherited IRA Mistake That Turns a $4,175 Monthly Paycheck Into a Tax Bill
summary: One phone call to your inherited IRA custodian can push an entire account into a single tax year. Before you ask for that check, learn which transfer method protects your money and how a ten-year clock changes your income plan.

title: How Many Shares of Realty Income, Simon Property or NNN REIT Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, $1,000 a month in dividends takes about $195,000 of NNN REIT, $213,600 of Realty Income or $292,800 of Simon Property Group. NNN REIT’s dividend is both the cheapest to fund and the best covered, which makes it my pick for a retiree.
